jei.dragom_golems.template.title: Large Golem Blank
jei.dragom_golems.template.desc: Cut it in a stonecutter to get the five dragon golem parts: wings, head, body, tail and limbs.
jei.dragom_golems.template.source: The blank itself has no crafting recipe yet - it can only be obtained by other means.
jei.dragom_golems.part.title: Dragon Golem Part
jei.dragom_golems.part.howto: On an anvil, put the part on the left and the material on the right. One stack must hold at least %s of that material.
jei.dragom_golems.part.formula: Part stats = material stats x part weight x dragon magnifier (health x3, attack x2).
jei.dragom_golems.part.limit: Modular Golems' copper / gold / iron / netherite ingots and sculk (echo shard) can be cast into dragon parts. Other golem materials work on dragons as well.
jei.dragom_golems.part.weight.head: Weights: head 1.0
jei.dragom_golems.holder.title: Dragon Golem
jei.dragom_golems.holder.desc: Assemble the five parts in the golem assembly table: W / HBT / L (W wings, H head, B body, T tail, L limbs).
jei.dragom_golems.holder.slot: Equipment screen is dog-typed: two slots, helmet and chestplate.
jei.dragom_golems.holder.hover: Gunship: hovers with its lowest model point at least 10 blocks above the ground. Retrieve it with a golem retrieval wand.
